soft_regions.reason: Build one coarse 3D MuJoCo flex covering this native patch with inner/perimeter pins attached to front_wheel. Use enclosing tetrahedra and nonnegative barycentric weights that reconstruct every render vertex; preserve original rest geometry and texture. Free outer nodes deform through real probe contact, never per-frame scripted displacement. Apply contact at stationary wheel, unload/recover, then demonstrate owner follow during continuous spin. Record any failed binding or deformation honestly.

interactions.name: rigid_demo
interactions.action: One host dynamics attempt: open/return both doors, steer negative/neutral/positive, compress/release fork, sweep/return wiper, and spin each wheel to an unwrapped target at least 2*pi then stop. Continuous hinges have limited=false and no MJCF range or actuator angle bound. Maintain supported preview offsets for all visual roots.
interactions.expected: Visible moving surfaces follow actual hierarchy; wheel accumulated angles cross a full turn. Measure endpoints and contact honestly, including partial/failed behavior.

interactions.name: continuity_check
interactions.action: Cheap geometric hierarchy check at minimum/middle/maximum finite motion, and wheel 0,pi/2,pi,3*pi/2: verify wheel-fork-fender ownership, sleeve overlap, door hinge edge and mirror attachment, wiper pivot. Record support gaps and implement only approved bounded additions. This is not another physics simulation.
interactions.expected: Native surfaces remain attached to actual moving owners with a continuous plausible support path; any remaining geometry gap explicit.

interactions.name: soft_demo
interactions.action: During the same host attempt, lock wheel at neutral, settle flex, press its outer tread with contact probe, unload and recover; bind native skin to real flex world positions. Then exercise rolling with pins following front_wheel.
interactions.expected: Measure displacement relative to rigid owner and recovery; reject rigid following as evidence of deformation. Preserve candidate if attempt fails.

review_requirements: Account for every native face exactly once across rigid and active-soft surfaces; preserve rest positions, UV and PBR. Inspect ownership views showing whole door/window/frame/handle/mirror assemblies, three distinct wheels, fender/fork separation, and a narrow wiper excluding underlying glazing. Record rest-frame and preview offsets; no empty or decorative core moving selections. Audit the two approved added-support area budgets separately and in total.

Using cheap geometry checks, inspect visible attachment at minimum/middle/maximum finite travel for both doors, steering, fork slide and wiper, and at wheel angles 0, pi/2, pi and 3*pi/2 without angular stops. Check outward door opening with mirror/window following, retained hinge edges, wheel-to-fork and fender ownership, positive sleeve overlap over fork travel, and wiper pivot continuity with a plausible sweep across glazing. Record gaps and overlaps; only approved bounded fork additions may repair supports. These checks are not extra dynamics runs.

In the one host mj_step attempt, exercise every named nonfixed joint and compare actual endpoints and visible surface movement with commanded targets. Each spin joint must compile limited=false without range or actuator angle clamping, and attempt at least 2*pi unwrapped travel; verify intermediate visible wheel motion, not just identical full-turn endpoints. Keep 90-degree door openings, +/-30-degree steering, finite wiper sweep and 0.04 m fork travel initially. Report actual endpoint errors and unstable or partial motion; any optional limited-joint backoff needs the frozen helper receipts, and continuous joints cannot be range-reduced.

Build nonempty front_tire_patch tetrahedra with free outer nodes and wheel-attached support pins. Verify nonnegative barycentric weights, rest reconstruction and exclusive visible skin binding. In the same host attempt, arrange probe access to the stationary patch without a rigid wheel proxy or floor shielding the contact; record settled, loaded, unloaded and recovered states, actual probe-flex contact and native-surface displacement relative to front_wheel under the declared test thresholds. Then check that patch pins and skin follow wheel spin and inherited steering without double transforms or detachment. Rigid following alone cannot pass deformation; keep failed attempt evidence and deferred-region labels.

Use simple enabled proxies that preserve cabin and wheel-opening clearance and disclose omissions. Record neutral and sampled contact depths under physics_tolerances.py: the 1% object-diagonal baseline needs no locality proof, while the extension requires actual helper locality evidence. Do not infer strict collision freedom or shrink ranges for tolerated seams. Deliver complete GLB/MJCF/action plan/manifest with separate planned, simulated-success, parameter-preview, failed and missing action statuses after the single host attempt, retaining native surfaces and supported mechanisms even when physics fails.

interaction_coverage.label: Independent wheel rolling
interaction_coverage.reason: Input front and near rear wheels plus both native rear wheels support three transverse axles; no evidence of angular stops.

interaction_coverage.label: Front wheel steering
interaction_coverage.reason: Fork enters front arch; estimated approximately upright pivot turns fork, fender, front axle and tire together. Initial oblique wheel pose is not an axis measurement.

interaction_coverage.label: Side door access
interaction_coverage.reason: Input near door seam/handle and native bilateral side outlines support opening assemblies; forward vertical hinge is an editable prior.

interaction_coverage.label: Windshield wiping
interaction_coverage.reason: Visible arm and lower pivot support finite sweep about windshield normal, not continuous rotation.

interaction_coverage.label: Front fork compression
interaction_coverage.reason: Exposed paired nested fork members support bounded telescopic prior; no claim of measured spring or stroke.

interaction_coverage.label: Local tire compression and recovery
interaction_coverage.reason: Rubber-like tread receives an actual visible nonrigid load attempt.

interaction_coverage.label: Additional tire and possible seat compliance
interaction_coverage.reason: Retain these surfaces without deformation claim while one tire patch is actively attempted.

approximation_gaps.reason: Door interiors and cavities remain native incomplete surfaces; only approved small fork connectors may be added. Wiper/glass and door boundaries are approximate. No fine reconstruction.

Simple enabled shell boxes/capsules and wheel cylinders omit detailed concave contact and glazing curvature. Do not fill cabin or wheel arches with solid chassis boxes. Retain generous motion; record tolerances and broad/deep failures without blanket contact exclusion.

Only one tire tread patch actively deforms; remaining tire surfaces and possible interior padding rigidly follow their owners without successful deformation claims. Pneumatic pressure and full tire constitutive behavior are omitted.
